title: Trust and R&D investments: evidence from OECD countries
summary: Social trust can increase R&D investment by expanding firms' access to external finance and by reducing relational risks that expose firms to hold-ups or expropriation.
keyFindings: Industries dependent on external finance have higher R&D intensity in trust-intensive countries.
Industries vulnerable to relational risks also have higher R&D intensity in trust-intensive countries.
Access to external finance and lower relational risk are causal pathways linking trust and R&D.
methods: Industry-level data on R&D investment intensity in 20 OECD countries.
